rationale: Strong runs (AREA 3, ABC buffering+sizing, timing-driven placement, post-GRT repairs, cap213) are capped at ss 100C by a port path whose slack moves ~0.8 ns per ns of target (scaled IO delays): T_eff ~ 0.2*target + D, D ~ 7.2-7.35 ns regardless of die size; reg-to-reg floors near 8.3 ns. D was best with GRT margin <=0.15 and 25% slew repair, worse with >=0.2 and >=30%. Hold, DRC and slew/cap (0 vs 850) have headroom. Both settings use that recipe at 8.16 ns, GRT margin 0.05, 20% slew/cap repair; one keeps AREA 3, the other tests DELAY 1 (lighter than bloated DELAY 3) to shorten the port cone.
